description: Phase 2 (2E): the human-gated filing review for one candidate. Prepared from a 2D evidence package by gauntlet/review.py:prepare_filing_review; decided by a human via record_review_decision. An approved review IS the F-5 second-eyes marker: its reviewer satisfies check_report_ready's review_2e requirement. No filing action is ever taken by this record.

fpp_band.description: BP-3 (PIPE50-2): the full [min, max] FPP band across the seeds. Null when no FPP was measured.

fpp_median.description: BP-3 (PIPE50-2): median FPP across the seeds — the central measurement. Null when no FPP was measured.

headline.description: BP-3 (PIPE50-2): the headline FPP — the MAX seed, the honest headline (a median that passes while one seed fails is not a PASS).

n_seeds.description: BP-3 (PIPE50-2): number of seeds behind this FPP. 1 means a single-seed run (PROVISIONAL_TRIAGE — not a validation measurement); 5 is the validation default.

per_seed.description: BP-3 (PIPE50-2): the per-seed FPP/NFPP values, in seed order.

reviewer_examined_evidence.description: The reviewer's attestation that they examined the evidence (the LATTE report, the TRICERATOPS numbers, the waived stages) — must be true to approve (P-6).

source_hashes_present.description: Whether every source the package cites was actually hashed (P-7): the verdict record, the desk natives, and every external-tool artifact. A null hash blocks approval.

eligible.description: Whether the package passed the filing gate at preparation: CANDIDATE verdict, every required stage pass-or-waived, persistence + diffimg + blend pass.

evidence_package_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the evidence package this review binds to.

operator.description: The person or agent who prepared the run (P-6) — usually Pingu, who ran the desk gauntlet. The reviewer must differ from the operator.

title: FilingReview
